bytes.</option><option value="show config supplied validation">Validate supplied configuration without applying it.</option></select></label></form><div id="graphical-supplied-inputs"><p>Compare two supplied configurations with secrets masked.</p><details><summary>About this inspection</summary><p>Compare two caller-held sources with the existing resolved diff and
secret masking. Decode content as one JSON object with required before and after
string fields, each holding native configuration text. Duplicate, missing,
unknown or nonstring fields and trailing data are refused. The combined JSON
envelope, not each individual source, has the content byte limit.</p></details><p>The complete input is limited to 195,840 bytes.
